question: What will fiscal Q4 2026 GAAP diluted EPS be for Broadcom?

calls.reasoning: Q4 revenue guide $34.8B at 66% non-GAAP op margin; Broadcom beats modestly (Q3: $29.6B vs $29.4B guide, 67.9% vs 67%), implying non-GAAP NI ~$19.0B and non-GAAP EPS ~$3.84, matching the ~$3.82-3.83 consensus. Over Q1-Q3 FY26, GAAP NI ran $2.8-3.3B below non-GAAP (amortization ~$2.0B, SBC ~$2.0-2.2B, offset by ~$1B tax adjustments). That gives GAAP NI ~$15.7B on ~4.89B diluted shares, or ~$3.20. Upside skew from possible fiscal-year-end discrete tax benefits (Q4 FY25 had a ~$2.1B statute-lapse benefit, +$0.43/sh). Downside from larger charges or a tax hit. Escape below $1.995 needs a >$6B charge, ~1%. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
